title: Sasu mom ko Neetu ne Diamond Ring Gift ki, Itni badi baat keh di Bhammu ne
description:
In this vlog by Lakhneet Vlogs, Neetu gets dolled up for the Teej festival and shares a glimpse of her beautiful traditional outfits. A major highlight of the video is when Neetu surprises her mother-in-law (Sasu mom) with a gorgeous peacock-designed diamond ring, who gets extremely happy with the sweet gesture. The family also spends time relishing famous Ghevar sweets from Chandni Chowk.

Later, Neetu and Diksha head to a lively Teej party with other ladies where they participate in singing, dancing, and fun games like "Guess the Song" and trivia. Returning home, Neetu unboxes her Teej gifts (Sindhara) from her mother and mother-in-law, revealing lovely suits and a saree. The vlog wraps up on a relatable family note, with Neetu strictly making Gopal finish his pending school homework late at night, followed by a cozy catch-up chat with Lakhan.

Key Moments
[00:29] Neetu gets ready for the Teej celebration and shows her festive outfits.
[02:28] Lakhan admires and reacts to Neetu's beautiful Teej look.
[03:36] Neetu surprises her mother-in-law with a stunning peacock diamond ring.
[05:37] The family enjoys famous Chandni Chowk Ghevar and other festival sweets.
[07:48] Neetu attends the Teej party with Diksha and plays the "Guess the Song" game.
[10:29] The ladies enjoy a fun balloon-popping trivia game at the Teej function.
[12:02] Neetu unboxes her Teej gifts (Sindhara), revealing gorgeous sarees and suits.
[13:58] Neetu scolds Gopal and strictly makes him complete his pending homework.
[15:05] Neetu and Lakhan have a lighthearted late-night conversation to wrap up the vlog.
